settings.title: Fit & Care
settings.content:
This is a pre-order. You order now, the run goes into production, and your size is cut with it and shipped to you first. You are charged at checkout, which is what reserves the size. If the run is delayed we write to you, and you can cancel for a full refund at any point before it ships.

Athletic fit. Shaped through the chest and shoulders, tapered through the body, close without pulling. It runs closer than the Portofino.

True to size if you want it close. If you sit between sizes, or you want it sitting looser through the middle, size up.

Machine wash cold. Reshape and dry flat so the knit holds its shape.

settings.title: Details
settings.content:
A knitted viscose and cotton blend with high stretch, so it moves with you and comes back into shape rather than bagging out at the elbows and hem.

The viscose gives the knit its drape and soft handle. The cotton keeps it breathable.

Open collar. Designed in Brisbane.

settings.title: Shipping

  • New Zealand: 2 to 4 days once dispatched. Free priority express over NZ$160.

Tracked door to door on every order.

settings.question: How does it fit?
settings.answer: An athletic fit. Shaped through the chest and shoulders and tapered through the body, close without pulling. It runs closer than the Portofino. True to size if you want it close, size up for more room through the middle.

settings.question: What is the fabric?
settings.answer: A knitted viscose and cotton blend with high stretch. The viscose gives it drape and a soft handle, the cotton keeps it breathable, and the stretch means it recovers its shape instead of bagging out.

settings.question: Is it comfortable for all day wear?
settings.answer: Yes. The stretch moves with you and the knit breathes, so it holds its line from morning through to evening.

settings.question: What should I pair it with?
settings.answer: Chinos and loafers for a long lunch. Tailored shorts by the water. It layers cleanly under a jacket when the evening cools.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Complimentary returns & exchanges within 44 days for AU/NZ orders. International orders: 44-day returns and exchanges, return shipping paid by the customer. All returns via our self-service portal, no emails, no waiting.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer:
This is a pre-order. You are charged at checkout, and that is what reserves your size in the run. Pre-orders are picked and sent first, ahead of general stock.

We write to you with the dispatch date as soon as the run is confirmed. If it slips you hear from us, and you can cancel for a full refund at any point before it ships.
